name: samesecond
description: Free watch parties: everyone plays their own video, only the timecode travels.

scripts.dev: npm run shared && node scripts/pack-extension.mjs http://localhost:8787 --target chrome --out public/downloads/samesecond-extension.zip && wrangler dev
scripts.lint:extension: npm run shared && node scripts/pack-extension.mjs --target firefox --dir dist/lint-firefox && npx --yes web-ext lint -s dist/lint-firefox
scripts.check:deploy: npm run shared && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.android:firefox: npm run shared && adb reverse tcp:8787 tcp:8787 && node scripts/pack-extension.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8787 --target firefox --dir dist/android-firefox && npx --yes web-ext run -t firefox-android -s dist/android-firefox --firefox-apk org.mozilla.firefox
